items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: they thought that I was gonna axe Bumps and have Lester in the band, but I intended to have both of them in the band.

ctx.x: And so -- as I stated before, they thought that I was gonna axe Bumps and have Lester in the band, but I intended to have both of them in the band.

So they wouldn't allow Lester to play with the band when he first arrived, and they told him that he had to appear as a guest; he could play three sets a night --but he had to play on the floor, he couldn't play on the bandstand with the band. And so he would come to Billy Berg's, and he had a little; he would set out back all night on a milk box waiting to come on, and we would play a set; we would play 3 sets a night, and then we would introduce Lester Young, and he'd come out and stand in the middle of the…
